messages:
Maya (Product): Kicking off hosted-api planning for next quarter. Primary goal is to decompose the OKR: "Reduce avg chat latency by 20% while keeping per-token cost <= 0.9x" and map launch criteria. Also need to cover embeddings throughput SLA ask and rerank quality guardrails. Post owners, rough timelines, and must-have launch checklist.

Raj (Eng-Platform): For runtime improvements we should target: kernel selection heuristics + KV cache rewrite + better batching. Realistic estimate: ~8w for full delivery. We can split into a 4w canary (kernel heuristics + perf infra) + 4w follow-up (cache + rollout infra). Can we gate canary as an opt-in?

Elena (Eng-ML): We have a promising 4-bit quantized variant for our main chat models that preserves quality in initial evals. Need to run rerank benchmarks against our baseline before recommending default. ETA: 3w for evals, 2w to wire into runtime for canary. Also need an auto-fallback path if quality dips.

Simon (DevEx): SDK/docs impact: streaming changes for chat + embeddings, plus a new retry semantics for rerank batch endpoints. I can own SDK work but need API contract frozen by EOW to avoid scope creep.

Nicole (Customer Success): Heads-up: large customer is asking for embeddings SLA (99.9% ingestion for index building). They sign if we can offer a dedicated path or an accelerated embeddings add-on. This is potential revenue — we should decide if Hosted should tackle or if we route to Dedicated.

Maya (Product): Tradeoff note: prioritizing runtime optimizations on Hosted helps chat latency broadly; embeddings SLA might require Dedicated or a fastpath because it's about availability/throughput guarantees. We need a go/no-go for a Dedicated pilot. Who can draft pricing/offer?

Raj (Eng-Platform): Recommend split approach: land runtime perf work on Hosted, but classify embeddings SLA as an "accelerated embeddings" add-on (likely Dedicated-backed). I'll draft technical constraints and a capacity model. We should also estimate incremental cost for the add-on.

Elena (Eng-ML): Rerank guardrail: propose automated evaluation hook + rollback to previous model variant if regression detected. Also want a small canary cohort (5% traffic) with latency/quality telemetry.

Simon (DevEx): Minimal launch criteria proposal: 1) Internal perf bench meets SLOs on target p50/p95 2) SDK + docs updated and shipped 3) 2-week canary with telemetry showing no quality regressions 4) Customer communication + opt-in for early adopters 5) Feature-flagged rollout + rollback path.

Maya (Product): OKR -> initiatives mapping and owners: runtime optimizations = Raj, ML quant variants & rerank = Elena, SDK/docs & developer signals = Simon, customer pilot & pricing = Nicole. Can we confirm rough dates?

Raj (Eng-Platform): Timeline: canary infra + kernel heuristics ready in ~4w, full runtime changes in ~8w. I'll create an RFC + milestones today and tag owners.

Nicole (Customer Success): I'll scope a pilot offer for the customer (Dedicated fastpath + pricing) and report back by Tue. If they're willing to pay, we might prioritize the accelerated embeddings slot.

Elena (Eng-ML): I'll start rerank evals mañana and post results in a dedicated thread. If numbers look good we can include the quant variant in the 4w canary.

Maya (Product): Action items: Raj = RFC + milestone, Elena = rerank benchmarks + PR, Simon = API contract by EOW + SDK plan, Nicole = customer pilot + pricing. I'll coordinate roadmap slot and write the OKR narrative. Ping me for blockers. :white_check_mark: 

deploy-bot: Reminder: last hosted-api deploy was 1769440000 — please coordinate canary windows with infra.

Raj (Eng-Platform): Noted — I'll add canary windows to the RFC and request infra time. Also adding perf infra ticket (track-#3421).

Simon (DevEx): Minor note: docs/examples need to show cost tradeoffs for quant variants and caching — I'll add a short FAQ.

Maya (Product): Great. We'll reconvene after initial RFCs and benchmarks. Thanks all. :rocket:
